agentera.title: Agentera
agentera.description: A skill ecosystem for autonomous software development. Provides structured, composable workflows — planning, execution, review, optimization — that turn LLM agents into reliable delivery systems with real guardrails.

opencode-vrida.title: Vrida
opencode-vrida.description: An OpenCode skill that assembles single-file HTML rigs with controls, live preview, and copyable prompt output. Visually tweak design tokens, architecture diagrams, and document reviews.

opencode-lfg.title: LFG
opencode-lfg.description: A workflow engine plugin for OpenCode that turns high-level objectives into deterministic delivery loops across research, planning, coding, review, and docs. Say "go build the feature" and get autonomous momentum with real guardrails.

finsliparn.title: Finsliparn
finsliparn.description: An MCP server that turns single-shot LLM coding into a multi-attempt refinement loop. Runs the test suite after each iteration, feeds failures back as structured directives, and picks the best passing solution using git worktrees.

spela.title: Spela
spela.description: A Linux gaming optimization tool that manages DLSS/DLL versions and per-game profiles for Steam/Proton games. Handles GPU/CPU tuning, HDR setup, and launch configuration.

utforskarn.title: Utforskarn
utforskarn.description: A local-first research tool for organizing topics into projects, with AI-powered auto-tagging and related-topic discovery. Write markdown notes, and an LLM analyzes them to surface connections you missed.

signalspanarn.title: Signalspanarn
signalspanarn.description: CLI and TUI that aggregates signals from Hacker News, GitHub, arXiv, Exa, and Kagi, then ranks and summarizes them so I can keep up with what's actually happening in AI without drowning in noise.

tuta.title: Tuta
tuta.description: A tiny CLI tool that plays synthesized notification tones for scripts and build pipelines. Each sound is designed around music theory principles — interval quality, pitch contour, waveform choice — so they're immediately recognizable without being annoying.
